The registry has one ARC contrast, corticosterone_4week_vs_vehicle. Table 1’s ten distinct four-week read totals match the ENA run totals for all ten GSM assignments. Supplementary Figure 1 identifies C01, C05 and C06 as outliers. Three vehicle mice (C02–04) and four corticosterone mice (C07–10) contribute the retained libraries. The manuscript documents laser capture, a 16-hour fast and 24 hours of refeeding. All 22,048 × 7 integer counts match the raw GEO deposit, with zero differences across 154,336 entries. Median-of-ratios normalization reproduces the deposited counts to a maximum absolute difference of 0.001179. The registered coefficient is groupcase in a filterByExpr/TMM/edgeR-QL fit. Both effects are signed log2 corticosterone relative to vehicle.

An independent join by source Ensembl ID reproduces every row of paired-effects.tsv.gz. There are 22,048 author rows, 15,430 finite effects, 11,207 tested registered rows and 11,182 published symbols. Nine published aggregates lack a single-feature counterpart. All 11,173 pairs are nonzero. Coverage is 99.919514% of registered effects and 72.410888% of finite author effects. The signs agree for 10,722 pairs (95.963483%). Pearson is 0.8995777062, average-rank Spearman 0.9657793679, median absolute difference 0.1715140489 and registered/author RMS effect ratio 2.1318517873. The v2 direction route passes and the correlation route falls short. The paper and project define the two cutoffs independently of the results.

GEO has 14,207 finite raw P and 9,082 finite adjusted P values. Among the pairs, 10,927 and 9,052 respectively are finite, leaving 246 and 2,121 unassessed. The seven-library fit has 6,618 all-zero rows, 1,223 additional finite effects without raw P, and 5,125 finite raw P values without adjusted P. At adjusted P < 0.1 the full author/registered/shared counts are 43/7/6 and the shared finite counts are 42/7/6. The 43 split 21 up and 22 down. Every paired author call agrees in sign. The six shared calls are Fam107a, Fam43a, Ina, Lars2, Npy and Zscan2. Ccdc106 lacks a published registered row. Only mt-Nd2 passes locally and misses the author cutoff (registered 0.06475503, GEO 0.122331067). At < 0.05 both universes give 14/5/5.

Among finite raw-P rows, baseMean reaches 29.18488465 without an adjusted P and starts at 29.18664038 with one. On the observed 9,082-row family, BH from the printed raw P values and BH from the two-sided Wald statistics each recover the exact 43 IDs. The maximum absolute differences from deposited adjusted P are 4.4553e-5 and 1.3790997e-9, respectively. Npy has Wald statistic −5.223964326, implied raw P 1.75132534e-7 and BH-adjusted P 0.0004631700327. Figure 2C’s caption gives the rounded raw P of 1.75e-7 under an adjusted-P label. GEO gives adjusted P 0.00046317, and both thesis tables give 4.63e-4. The historical sensitivity entry was checked against the original ledger blob and its R and Python scripts. It reports 47 calls under the refit’s independent filtering and all 43 author IDs after conditioning on the observed author mask. I did not rerun that historical fit.
